SELECT CAST(s.id AS varchar) AS id, CAST(s.tenant_id AS varchar) AS tenant_id, s.factory_code, #{ownerType} AS owner_type,
s.customer_code AS code, s.customer_name AS name, s.status AS enabled, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS supplier_check_status FROM mom_mdm.mdm_customer s
s.supplier_code AS code, s.supplier_name AS name, s.status AS enabled, s.check_status AS supplier_check_status FROM mom_mdm.mdm_supplier s
WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND s.del_flag = '0'
